title: Complexity of Normalized Persistence Problems for Topological Data Analysis and Local Hamiltonians
abstract: arXiv:2607.03278v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Topological data analysis (TDA) is a machine learning technique that uses topology to extract patterns from data and has shown the potential to exhibit quantum advantage. A key concept in TDA is persistent homology, which measures the robustness of topological information at different lengthscales. In this paper, we introduce and study the problem of normalized persistence, a practically motivated and easily interpretable version of persistent homology that counts the fraction of holes that persist at different lengthscales. We prove that a variant of normalized persistence is $\mathsf{DQC}_1$-hard and contained in $\mathsf{BQP}$, giving evidence of an exponential quantum speedup for TDA under the standard assumption that $\mathsf{DQC}_1 \not\subseteq \mathsf{BPP}$. translated_title: 拓扑数据分析与局域哈密顿量的归一化持续性问题复杂度
translated_abstract: 拓扑数据分析（TDA）是一种利用拓扑学从数据中提取模式的机器学习技术，并已展现出获得量子优势的潜力。TDA中的一个关键概念是持续同调，它衡量拓扑信息在不同长度尺度上的鲁棒性。在本文中，我们引入并研究了归一化持续性问题，这是持续同调的一种有实际动机且易于解释的版本，它计算在不同长度尺度上持续存在的孔洞所占的比例。我们证明了归一化持续性的一个变体是𝖣𝖰𝖢₁-难的，且包含于𝖡𝖰𝖯之中，从而在𝖣𝖰𝖢₁ ⊄ 𝖡𝖯𝖯这一标准假设下，为TDA存在指数级量子加速提供了证据。这些是关于团复形的首批𝖣𝖰𝖢₁-难结果，使其可直接应用于TDA实例。我们还发现了……之间的紧密联系（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了归一化持续性这一持续同调的实用且易解释的变体，证明了其𝖣𝖰𝖢₁-难且属于𝖡𝖰𝖯，为拓扑数据分析具有指数级量子加速提供了首个针对团复形的证据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces normalized persistence, a practically motivated and interpretable variant of persistent homology, and proves it is 𝖣𝖰𝖢₁-hard and contained in 𝖡𝖰𝖯, providing the first evidence of exponential quantum speedup for topological data analysis on clique complexes.
